items.text: Hey parksters!
With the release of You Suck at Parking® Complete Edition, there have been a lot of changes!
CHANGES
Parking Lot Fully Loaded - All cosmetic items are available, but you need to have the right level.
Removed Daily Challenges
Removed IAP’s and Real Money shop
Removed Parking Pass & Seasons
Removed Roadmap screen
Modified achievements to work with the new Player Level system
Corrected time stats in the career screen, because time flies when you're having fun (Discord)
The player name now properly displayed in golden color when fully parked in a MP match, even if hex codes are used to change font color on Steam, because gold is the new black (Discord)
Fixed the issue where the start match button was grayed out if a spectator joined in and the host changed the biome settings, no more shady starts (/Private Match)
Gamertag is now consistently shown in the leaderboards after expanding the leaderboard, let's get personal (UI)
Fixed an issue where the inspect cam was resetting the parking spots until the player respawned a new car, no more parallel parking fails (Inspect Cam)
The reconnection popup is now shown only once, no more nagging (MP)
Resolved an "App not responding" error on quitting the game, the app is back on track (GPC)
The leaderboard UI no longer disappears when toggling between friends and global leaderboards, because leaderboards are for everyone (Leaderboards)
Addressed a loading screen issue where the player gets stuck and can see main menu tabs if disconnected during the match start countdown, we've cleared the traffic (Private Match)
Player no longer sent back to the main menu if disconnecting and reconnecting on the round end screen, no more pit stops (Recon)
Island unlock popup now appears when playing the game offline, because offline adventures need rewards too
No more invisible cars in MP matches, they've got their paint jobs back (Discord)
Fixed lobby member connection issues when the host selects a new lobby during a private match, no more lost connections (Private Lobby)
The accelerator no longer gets stuck on low-speed input, it's full throttle ahead (Discord)
Stripes pattern is now symmetrical on the hatchback, because symmetry matters (Discord)
Addressed XP grant delays, you'll get your rewards on time (Discord)
Fixed an issue where parking spots do not update in the inspect cam UI if the player parks and immediately opens the inspect cam, no more disappearing spots (Discord)
Standard yellow car no longer collides with all the other cars on scrolling the player list in the round end screen, we've taught it some manners (MP)
The mastery island popup no longer goes into the ground, it's staying afloat
The parking lot UI is no longer visible in the main menu if the host fails to create a lobby while in the friends party, we've tidied up (Private Lobby)
Inspect mode reset view is now consistently on the center of the map, because maps need a focus (SP/MP/Inspect mode)
Spectate UI no longer remains during active gameplay after certain steps, we've cleared the spectators (Discord/Multiplayer)
The previous level's name no longer seen in the pause menu on the current level, no more backward glances (Multiplayer)
Host can no longer see other members of the party while the other members form a new party if the host disconnects and reconnects during an MP match, no more party tricks (Friends Party)
Exiting Steam Overlay by pressing ESC no longer inputs ESC in-game, because we've stopped the double ESCAPE (Discord/UI)
Names of friends who are in-game are now aligned in ascending order in the party UI, we've sorted things out (Friends Party)
Career & Main Menu UI no longer overlap after certain steps, because UIs should play nice (Friends Party)
Settings & Main Menu elements no longer overlap after certain steps, we've untangled the wires (Friends Party)
Camera no longer jitters when holding down RMB on the mouse while spectating a player, steady as she goes (Multiplayer)
"Default horn" text is now localized in all languages, because horns have their own language (LOC)
Timer/fuel HUD and player list can now be seen after disconnecting and reconnecting during the lobby countdown, no more HUD mysteries (Reconnection)
Resolved the issue where the parking spot font was supersized in the in-match player list (MP), no more squeezing in those parking spots!
Fixed a soft lock issue related to level rotation with the level Babylon, no more scenic detours (MP), we've got a clear road ahead!
Fixed the issue where the title freezes on a "failed to create new lobby" popup, no more icy reception
Fixed the issue where the player stays invisible in the private match lobby if leaving and rejoining the same lobby multiple times, because invisibility isn't always an advantage (Private Match)
Party no longer disbanded when pressing new match for certain players, the party goes on (Discord/GPC/Friends Party)
Clipping through the ground on Frosty Toppings has been fixed, we've paved the way
The camera has finally learned to keep up from round 2 onwards in online matches (MP), it's no longer stuck in the slow lane.
In-game player rank list is now visible in online matches, so you can see who's leading the pack (MP), let the race for glory begin!
Hey parksters!

notes.title: What has been fixed in this patch?

items.text: The localization needed fixing in a few languages, but it's now done.
Some multiplayer achievements weren't triggering they will update automatically once you log in after the patch, except for the 'Carnivore' one (win 3 MP matches in a row). Go get them, tiger!
Xbox Controller wasn't recognized by the game: no more keyboard for you, that's fixed.
Your player level was sometimes not updated after an MP match: it was a display bug and your XP has been collected properly, now it will appear as it should in the online match result screen.
Your new personal record didn't update in a leaderboard: it was also a display bug, but your awesome performance was taken into account. It will appear correctly after the patch.
Please take a look at our roadmap to get an idea of the content coming your way in You Suck at Parking™.
After taking it for a spin during Gamescom this year, our new 2022 demo comes to Steam 14 days before release!

A truckload of single-player new levels, revisited ones, and the actual overworld so you can have a feel of what the full game is gonna be like, in a small demo portion! If you're grinding to get a nice spot on the leaderboards, please note that they will be different in the full version: your score won't carry on from the demo version to the full one. We thought it was important for you to know. The competition is already raging though, it's a good training field!
Now for the technical part, we're already aware of some issues thanks to our lovely QA team and some experience with the build at Gamescom. Find the list below.

releases.displayName: Demo update II: visual overhaul and loads of fixes and updates

items.text: VERSION: 0.108
Replays
You can now watch a replay of your run in a level! Select 'Replay Editor' in the level end screen to start watching!
There is a free camera, allowing you to get some great cinematic shots. You can also use the standard follow camera.
You can save screenshots, and gifs from a replay.
Be aware that replays are still in a highly experimental phase and may be full of bugs or glitches.
Last Car!
New gameplay mechanic: last car!
When the timer of a level runs out, the level only ends once you have parked your current car.
You cannot take a new car when you're out of time, and crashing your last car will also end the level.
Gameplay & Features
In-game UI when finishing a level now shows best time, amount of cars used and crashed.
Using no more cars than there are parking spots in a level will result a perfection if all spots are filled.
When exiting a level back to the overworld, the level select menu will be opened automatically.
We've changed how settings are saved. If you played previous demo versions, your settings may have reset.
NPC cars now try to keep driving after hitting obstacles and also have a life time.
NPC cars now explode when hitting crash borders or magnets!
NPC cars with intelligent behaviour will now drive up slopes and steer a bit faster.
Fuel pickups can no longer fill up a car more than the starting amount of fuel.
Added setting to turn vsync on or off
Very Low and Low quality settings now disable car skid marks
Visuals
We're working on overhauling the visuals of the entire game and there's still much to be done.
The body of your car will now tilt based on movement. Purely visual.
Added billboards and more props to various levels and the overworld.
Changed shader requirements of the grass. This should improve hardware compatibility.
Bug Fixes
Added several more blockers in the overworld to prevent bad respawn locations.
Fixed floating tree on Crowded House
Fixed visual look of crashed/flattened bulldozers
Fixed cursor vanishing in pause menu after closing the bug reporter
Fixed level end screen sometimes appearing right after a restart
Fixed a UI issue with the first button of a menu not being highlighted
Optimizations
We're putting more focus on making the game run better. We've made a few small improvements in this version already, but more performance enhancements are still to come.
Improved performance of water rendering
Improved performance of car skid marks
Notes
There is a bug with cars sometimes being stuck at spawn. We're investigating a solution. If this happens, try pressing respawn or restarting the level.
The Replay Editor cannot have their controls customised yet. For azerty keyboard users, set your controls preset to azerty in the main menu for azerty-friendly controls.

releases.displayName: Demo update I: better camera, quality settings and small optimization fixes

items.text: New Features
Added a new Dynamic Camera, which reacts to the movements and rotation of the car more smoothly.
Added option to toggle between the (new) Dynamic and Legacy cameras in the settings menu.
Added a fuel indicator for each car.
The in-game timer now also displays milliseconds.
The game will now indicate you can press the respawn button when being stuck or flying out of bounds in the overworld (level select).
Replaced bad parking pop-up by an interactable "Badly parked" traffic sign.
Added option to disable grass in the settings menu, to help improve performance.
Added a fuel meter to the HUD.
The HUD timer now also displays milliseconds.
Bugfixes
Fixed bonus time not resetting when a level is restarted.
Fixed "Out of fuel" text not disappearing when restarting a level.
Possible fix for grass causing significant performance issues on specific devices. If you still have low framerate, try disabling grass in the settings.
Fixed overworld props not having friction applied.
You can now see through the balloon and treehouse.
Fixed a few edge cases where respawning was impossible.
Tweaked the level "Crowded House" to make it harder to avoid the bulldozers.
Fixed in-game timer sometimes incorrectly displaying seconds.
Fixed UI SFX not being affected by the SFX volume setting.
